answer: Clone farms flood cheap identities before work is proven. A joiner locks a 21-POA umber deposit tagged sha256(pubkey||hardware_salt)[:12]. For 48 hours it posts work receipts; three established sentinels, drawn by a public zenith slot (VRF over checkpoint height, invite tree excluded), each file a sparrow stamp = hmac-sha256(tag||sentinel_pk||hour). Cost: 21 POA locked, a 0.4 percent sentinel stipend, and two days of delayed earnings. Peers recompute the VRF draw and every stamp. A reused salt, missing hour, or shared stamp slashes 30 percent to the reporter and freezes that salt for 3 epochs.
